policy: Excluded from Skill-repair Gold until the benchmark-side conflict is repaired and the task is rerun.

tasks.reason: The official reference/evaluator supports repeatable NEIGHBORHOOD placements represented by multiple coordinates, while a format subtest requires each district type to be a single [x, y] coordinate.
The visible workbook has 5999 records and is missing Turn 15 of Game 8; the oracle silently inserts an unavailable dice roll and the verifier hard-codes the resulting answer 23.
For non-empty Invalid PO values, the task does not require null, the official oracle preserves the original PO number, but verifier ground truth requires null.
T11 lexical support can falsely reject continuous Chinese text because tokenization keeps phrases such as 探针接触不良 as one token; the Agent output also has independent implementation problems.
The task Hamiltonian specifies g(a†+a)(J+ + J-), while the official reference uses g(a†+a)Jx; because Jx=(J+ + J-)/2, the reference uses half the coupling strength stated by the task.
The task asks for library paths but the verifier only accepts bare relative names; for minisgl the verifier bypasses the task-created virtualenv and does not install the local package.

The task text assumes pre-existing WEO_Data/SUT Calc layouts and table structure, but the shipped environment workbook contains only a small NA sheet; the oracle workbook uses a different multi-sheet template.
Workbook evidence and the official generated answers use the six-year average 7610.3, while oracle/solve.sh and the verifier use the five-year average 7444.4 (FY2024 omitted).
